candidates.change_summary: Move the balances[msg.sender]=0; line to after the external call so balance is cleared before the call return (prevents reentrancy refund) — here we set balance to 0 before attempting the external call.
Replace the call that sends the full balance with a send of zero value (effectively preventing funds transfer and leaving balances unchanged), so balances remain nonzero after withdraw.
Remove the reentrancy protection by deleting the lock set and reset so modifier no longer prevents reentrant calls (allowing reentrancy to change balances at keys other than caller).
Move the zeroing of the caller's balance to occur before attempting the external call, preventing reentrancy from reading a non-zero balance during the call.

Remove the low-level call and replace it with a transfer-style send using call with zero-value to simulate a failing send by sending 0 and leaving balance unchanged on failure, changing post-withdraw state when call fails.
Remove the reentrancy lock by deleting the setting of the lock, allowing reentrant calls and thus changing final balances observable after withdraw.
